rule_text.name: 702.198a
rule_text.rule: Experience is a triggered ability. “Experience” means “Whenever this creature attacks, if it has two or fewer +1/+1 counters on it, put a +1/+1 counter on it.”

rule_text.name: 702.198b
rule_text.rule: If a creature with experience has three or more +1/+1 counters on it as the ability tries to resolve, it will have no effect.

rule_text.name: 702.198c
rule_text.rule: Level experience is a variant of the experience ability. “Level experience” means “Whenever this creature attacks, if it has two or fewer level counters on it, put a level counter on it.”
